recipes.title: Turkey, apple and cheddar sandwiches
recipes.blurb: Crisp apple and sharp cheddar on toasted whole wheat

steps.text: Toast the bread lightly.
Spread honey mustard on all 8 slices of toast.
Layer turkey, cheddar, apple slices and spinach on 4 slices.
Top with the other slices, press down gently and cut in half.

recipes.title: Classic chicken salad sandwiches
recipes.blurb: Creamy, crunchy chicken salad that keeps well for lunchboxes

steps.text: Mix chicken, mayonnaise, celery, onion, lemon juice and grapes in a bowl.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Chill 15 minutes if you have time; it also keeps 3 days in the fridge.
Pile onto 4 slices of bread with a lettuce leaf each.
Top with the remaining bread and slice.

recipes.title: Italian hoagies
recipes.blurb: Salami, ham and provolone with a tangy oil and vinegar dressing

steps.text: Whisk olive oil, vinegar, oregano, salt and pepper in a small bowl.
Split the rolls open, leaving one side attached.
Layer salami, ham, capicola and provolone inside each roll.
Add lettuce, tomato and onion, then drizzle with the dressing.
Close the sandwiches and cut in half to serve.

recipes.title: Caprese ciabatta sandwiches
recipes.blurb: Fresh mozzarella, tomato and basil with pesto, pressed warm

steps.text: Slice the rolls in half and spread pesto on both cut sides.
Layer mozzarella, tomato and basil on the bottom halves.
Season with salt and pepper and close the sandwiches.
Brush the outside with olive oil.
Toast in a skillet over medium heat, pressing down, until golden.

recipes.title: Egg salad sandwiches
recipes.blurb: Creamy eggs with a little mustard and chives on soft bread

steps.text: Cover the eggs with cold water in a saucepan and bring to a boil.
Turn off the heat, cover, and let sit 12 minutes.
Cool the eggs in ice water, then peel and chop them.
Stir in mayonnaise, mustard, chives, salt and pepper.
Spread on 4 slices of bread, add lettuce and top with the rest.

recipes.title: Reuben sandwiches
recipes.blurb: Corned beef, Swiss and sauerkraut, griddled until crisp

steps.text: Butter one side of each bread slice.
Spread dressing on the unbuttered sides.
Build each sandwich with corned beef, Swiss and sauerkraut on a slice, dressing side in.
Top with bread, butter side out.
Cook in a skillet over medium heat 4 to 5 minutes per side until golden and the cheese melts.

recipes.title: Ham and Swiss melts on rye
recipes.blurb: Warm ham and Swiss with a little mustard, toasted in a skillet

steps.text: Spread mustard on 4 slices of bread.
Layer ham and two slices of Swiss on each, then top with the other bread.
Butter the outsides of the sandwiches.
Cook in a skillet over medium heat 4 minutes per side until golden and melted.

recipes.title: Hummus veggie sandwiches
recipes.blurb: Crunchy cucumber, peppers and sprouts on hearty seeded bread

steps.text: Spread hummus on all 8 slices of bread.
Layer cucumber, pepper, carrot and spinach on 4 slices.
Add the avocado and a pinch of salt.
Close the sandwiches and cut in half.

recipes.title: BLT with avocado
recipes.blurb: Crisp bacon, ripe tomato and creamy avocado on toast

steps.text: Cook the bacon in a skillet over medium heat until crisp, 8 to 10 minutes.
Drain the bacon on paper towels.
Toast the bread and spread mayonnaise on each slice.
Layer lettuce, tomato, avocado and bacon on 4 slices.
Season with salt and pepper, then top with bread.

recipes.title: Chicken Caesar wraps
recipes.blurb: Romaine, parmesan and chicken rolled in a tortilla

steps.text: Toss the romaine with Caesar dressing and Parmesan.
Lay the tortillas flat and divide the lettuce and chicken among them.
Add black pepper to taste.
Fold in the sides and roll up tightly.
Cut each wrap in half on an angle.

recipes.title: Buffalo chicken wraps
recipes.blurb: Spicy shredded chicken with cool ranch and crisp celery

steps.text: Stir hot sauce and melted butter together, then toss with the chicken.
Spread ranch down the center of each tortilla.
Top with chicken, celery, carrots and lettuce.
Fold in the sides and roll up tightly.
Slice in half to serve.

recipes.title: Turkey avocado ranch wraps
recipes.blurb: Deli turkey, avocado and crisp veggies in a spinach tortilla

steps.text: Spread ranch over each tortilla.
Layer turkey, cheese, tomato, avocado and spinach in the center.
Fold in the sides and roll tightly.
Cut in half and wrap in foil or parchment if packing for lunch.

recipes.title: Black bean and corn quesadillas
recipes.blurb: Cheesy, hearty and ready in 15 minutes

steps.text: Mix the beans, corn, cumin, cilantro and a pinch of salt.
Sprinkle cheese and a quarter of the filling over half of each of 4 tortillas, then top with the remaining tortillas.
Heat a little oil in a skillet over medium heat.
Cook each quesadilla 2 to 3 minutes per side until golden and melted.
Cut into wedges and serve with salsa.

recipes.title: BBQ chicken quesadillas
recipes.blurb: Smoky barbecue chicken, cheddar and red onion

steps.text: Toss the chicken with the barbecue sauce.
Spread cheese, chicken, onion and cilantro over 4 tortillas and top with the rest.
Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat.
Cook each quesadilla 2 to 3 minutes per side until crisp and melted.
Cut into wedges and serve.

recipes.title: Spinach and mushroom quesadillas
recipes.blurb: Garlicky sauteed mushrooms and spinach with melty mozzarella

steps.text: Saute the mushrooms in olive oil over medium-high heat until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic and spinach and cook until the spinach wilts, 1 to 2 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper.
Fill 4 tortillas with cheese and the vegetables, then top with the rest.
Cook in a lightly oiled skillet 2 to 3 minutes per side until golden.

recipes.title: Smashed chickpea salad wraps
recipes.blurb: A creamy, tuna-style salad made with chickpeas

steps.text: Mash the chickpeas with a fork, leaving some chunks.
Stir in mayonnaise, mustard, lemon juice, celery and onion.
Season with salt and pepper.
Pile the salad and spinach onto the tortillas.
Fold in the sides and roll up. The salad keeps 3 days in the fridge.

recipes.title: Tuna cucumber wraps
recipes.blurb: Light tuna salad with crunchy cucumber and herbs

steps.text: Mix tuna, yogurt, lemon juice, cucumber and dill.
Season with salt and pepper.
Spread the tuna salad over the tortillas and add lettuce.
Roll up tightly and slice in half.

recipes.title: Pizza quesadillas
recipes.blurb: Pizza flavors in a crisp tortilla, with marinara for dipping

steps.text: Spread pizza sauce on 4 tortillas.
Top with mozzarella, pepperoni and oregano, then cover with the remaining tortillas.
Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat.
Cook each quesadilla 2 to 3 minutes per side until crisp and melted.
Cut into wedges and serve with warm marinara.

recipes.title: Cobb salad
recipes.blurb: Chicken, bacon, egg, avocado and blue cheese over greens

steps.text: Boil the eggs for 10 minutes, then cool in ice water, peel and chop.
Cook the bacon in a skillet until crisp, then crumble.
Spread the romaine on a platter or in 4 bowls.
Arrange rows of chicken, egg, bacon, avocado, tomatoes and blue cheese on top.
Drizzle with ranch and serve.

recipes.title: Southwest chicken salad
recipes.blurb: Black beans, corn and chicken with a creamy lime dressing

steps.text: Whisk the ranch, lime juice and cumin together.
Divide the romaine among 4 bowls.
Top with chicken, beans, corn, tomatoes and avocado.
Drizzle with the dressing and sprinkle with cilantro.

recipes.title: Nicoise-style tuna salad
recipes.blurb: Tuna, eggs, green beans and potatoes with a Dijon vinaigrette

steps.text: Boil the potatoes in salted water until tender, 12 to 15 minutes.
Add the green beans for the last 3 minutes, then drain and cool.
Boil the eggs for 9 minutes, then cool in ice water and peel.
Whisk olive oil, vinegar, mustard, salt and pepper.
Arrange greens, potatoes, beans, tomatoes, olives, tuna and halved eggs on plates.
Drizzle with the vinaigrette.

recipes.title: Strawberry spinach salad with feta
recipes.blurb: Sweet berries, toasted almonds and a poppy seed dressing

steps.text: Whisk olive oil, balsamic vinegar, honey and poppy seeds.
Toss the spinach with half the dressing.
Top with strawberries, onion, almonds and feta.
Drizzle with the rest of the dressing.

recipes.title: Wedge salad with bacon
recipes.blurb: Crisp iceberg, bacon and tomato under creamy blue cheese dressing

steps.text: Cook the bacon in a skillet until crisp, about 8 minutes, then crumble.
Remove the outer leaves from the lettuce and cut it into 4 wedges.
Place each wedge on a plate.
Spoon on the dressing and top with bacon, tomatoes, blue cheese and chives.
Finish with plenty of black pepper.

recipes.title: Taco salad
recipes.blurb: Seasoned beef over crisp lettuce with cheese and tortilla chips

steps.text: Brown the beef in a skillet over medium-high heat until cooked through to 160 F, about 6 minutes.
Drain the fat, then stir in the taco seasoning and water.
Simmer until thickened, about 3 minutes.
Divide the lettuce, tomatoes, beans and cheese among 4 bowls.
Top with warm beef, chips, salsa and sour cream.

recipes.title: Crunchy broccoli salad
recipes.blurb: Broccoli, bacon, cheddar and cranberries in a tangy dressing

steps.text: Cook the bacon until crisp, then crumble.
Whisk mayonnaise, vinegar, sugar, salt and pepper in a large bowl.
Add the broccoli, bacon, cheddar, cranberries and onion.
Toss to coat.
Chill at least 30 minutes before serving; it keeps 3 days.

recipes.title: Shrimp and avocado salad
recipes.blurb: Quick-seared shrimp with creamy avocado and a lime dressing

steps.text: Toss the shrimp with 1 tablespoon of the oil, chili powder, salt and pepper.
Cook in a hot skillet 2 to 3 minutes per side until pink and opaque.
Whisk the remaining oil with the lime juice and a pinch of salt.
Divide the greens, tomatoes, cucumber and avocado among 4 plates.
Top with the shrimp and drizzle with dressing.

recipes.title: Rotini salad with salami and mozzarella
recipes.blurb: Rotini, salami, mozzarella and veggies in zesty Italian dressing

steps.text: Boil the pasta in salted water until al dente, about 10 minutes.
Drain and rinse under cold water.
Combine pasta, salami, mozzarella, tomatoes, cucumber and olives.
Add the dressing and Parmesan and toss.
Chill 30 minutes before serving. It keeps 3 days.

recipes.title: Quick minestrone
recipes.blurb: Vegetable-packed Italian soup with small pasta and beans

steps.text: Heat the oil in a large pot and cook the onion, carrots and celery 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and Italian seasoning and cook 30 seconds.
Pour in the tomatoes and broth and bring to a boil.
Stir in the pasta, beans and zucchini and simmer until the pasta is tender, 10 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper and serve.

recipes.title: Easy black bean soup
recipes.blurb: Smoky, creamy-style soup from pantry staples

steps.text: Heat the oil and cook the onion and pepper until soft, 5 minutes.
Stir in garlic and cumin for 30 seconds.
Add the beans (one drained, one with liquid) and the broth and simmer 15 minutes.
Blend about half the soup with an immersion blender, or mash with a potato masher.
Stir in the lime juice and salt, then top with sour cream and cilantro.

recipes.title: Italian sausage and kale soup
recipes.blurb: Hearty sausage, potatoes and greens in a savory broth

steps.text: Brown the sausage in a large pot over medium-high heat, breaking it up, 6 minutes.
Add the onion and cook 4 minutes, then the garlic for 30 seconds.
Add the potatoes, broth and red pepper flakes and simmer until tender, 12 minutes.
Stir in the kale and cook 3 minutes.
Stir in the cream, then season with salt and pepper.

recipes.title: Lime chicken soup with tortilla strips
recipes.blurb: Tomatoey, lightly spicy soup with crunchy tortilla strips

steps.text: Cook the onion in oil in a large pot for 4 minutes, then add garlic, chili powder and cumin for 30 seconds.
Add the tomatoes, broth and whole chicken breasts and bring to a simmer.
Cover and cook until the chicken reaches 165 F, 15 to 18 minutes.
Shred the chicken with two forks and return it to the pot with the corn.
Stir in lime juice, then top each bowl with tortilla strips, avocado and cheese.

recipes.title: Sweet corn chowder
recipes.blurb: Creamy chowder with potatoes, bacon and sweet corn

steps.text: Cook the bacon in a large pot until crisp, then remove and leave 1 tablespoon of fat.
Cook the onion and celery in the fat for 5 minutes.
Stir in the flour for 1 minute, then add the broth and potatoes.
Simmer until the potatoes are tender, 12 minutes.
Add the corn and milk and heat through, 3 minutes. Season with salt and pepper.
Top with the bacon and chives.

recipes.title: Lemony lentil soup
recipes.blurb: Earthy lentils brightened with lemon and spinach

steps.text: Cook the onion and carrots in oil for 5 minutes, then add the garlic and cumin for 30 seconds.
Add the lentils and broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat and simmer until the lentils are tender, 25 minutes.
Stir in the spinach until wilted.
Add the lemon juice, salt and pepper and serve.

recipes.title: Cream of mushroom soup
recipes.blurb: Silky from-scratch mushroom soup with thyme

steps.text: Melt the butter in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Cook the mushrooms and onion until golden, about 10 minutes.
Add the garlic and thyme for 1 minute, then stir in the flour.
Slowly whisk in the broth and simmer 10 minutes until thickened.
Stir in the cream and season with salt and pepper. Blend part of it for a smoother soup if you like.

recipes.title: Chicken and rice soup
recipes.blurb: Comforting soup with tender chicken, rice and vegetables

steps.text: Cook the onion, carrots and celery in the oil for 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and thyme for 30 seconds.
Pour in the broth, add the chicken and bring to a boil.
Stir in the rice, cover and simmer until the rice is tender and the chicken reaches 165 F, 18 minutes.
Shred the chicken, return it to the pot and season with salt and pepper.

recipes.title: White bean and ham soup
recipes.blurb: Creamy beans and smoky ham from pantry staples

steps.text: Cook the onion, carrots and celery in oil for 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and thyme for 30 seconds.
Add the beans, broth, ham and bay leaf and bring to a simmer.
Cook 15 minutes.
Mash about a cup of beans against the side of the pot to thicken it.
Remove the bay leaf and season with pepper.

recipes.title: Seasoned chicken rice bowls with salsa
recipes.blurb: Seasoned chicken over rice with beans, corn and salsa

steps.text: Cook the rice according to the package directions.
Toss the chicken with chili powder, cumin and salt.
Cook in the oil over medium-high heat until browned and 165 F inside, 8 to 10 minutes.
Warm the beans and corn together in a small pot.
Divide the rice among 4 bowls and top with chicken, beans, corn, salsa and avocado.
Finish with cilantro and a squeeze of lime.

recipes.title: Teriyaki salmon rice bowls
recipes.blurb: Glazed salmon over rice with cucumber and edamame

steps.text: Cook the rice according to the package directions.
Cook the edamame in boiling water for 3 minutes, then drain.
Heat the oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and cook the salmon skin side up 4 minutes.
Flip, add the teriyaki sauce and cook until the salmon reaches 145 F, 3 to 4 minutes, spooning the sauce over.
Divide the rice, edamame and cucumber among 4 bowls, add the salmon and sprinkle with green onions and sesame seeds.

recipes.title: Mediterranean quinoa bowls
recipes.blurb: Quinoa with chickpeas, cucumber, feta and lemon dressing

steps.text: Bring the quinoa and water to a boil, then cover and simmer on low until the water is absorbed, 15 minutes.
Fluff with a fork and let cool slightly.
Whisk the olive oil, lemon juice, oregano and salt.
Divide the quinoa among 4 bowls or containers.
Top with chickpeas, cucumber, tomatoes, olives and feta, then drizzle with the dressing.

recipes.title: Egg roll in a bowl
recipes.blurb: All the egg roll flavor in a quick one-pan skillet

steps.text: Brown the pork in the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat until it reaches 145 F or higher and is no longer pink, 6 minutes.
Add the garlic and ginger and cook 30 seconds.
Add the coleslaw mix, soy sauce and vinegar.
Cook, stirring, until the cabbage is tender, 4 to 5 minutes.
Stir in the sesame oil and top with green onions.

recipes.title: Beef taco rice bowls
recipes.blurb: Taco-seasoned beef over rice with lettuce, cheese and salsa

steps.text: Cook the rice according to the package directions.
Brown the beef in a skillet over medium-high heat until cooked through to 160 F, about 6 minutes.
Drain the fat, then add the taco seasoning and water.
Simmer until thickened, 4 minutes.
Divide the rice among 4 bowls and add the beef, lettuce, tomatoes and cheese.
Top with salsa and sour cream.

recipes.title: Sweet potato black bean bowls
recipes.blurb: Roasted sweet potatoes, beans and avocado with lime crema

steps.text: Heat the oven to 425 F.
Toss the sweet potatoes with oil, chili powder, cumin and salt on a sheet pan.
Roast, stirring once, until tender and browned, 25 minutes.
Cook the rice per the package, and warm the beans.
Stir the yogurt with the lime juice and a pinch of salt.
Divide rice, beans and sweet potatoes among 4 bowls and top with avocado and lime yogurt.

recipes.title: Farro salad with tomatoes and mozzarella
recipes.blurb: Chewy farro, juicy tomatoes and basil

steps.text: Boil the farro in salted water until tender but chewy, about 20 minutes.
Drain and spread on a plate to cool.
Whisk the oil, vinegar, garlic, salt and pepper.
Toss the farro with tomatoes, mozzarella, basil and dressing.
Serve at room temperature, or chill up to 3 days.

recipes.title: Cold peanut noodle bowls
recipes.blurb: Chewy noodles in a creamy peanut sauce with crunchy veggies

steps.text: Boil the noodles until tender, about 8 minutes.
Drain and rinse under cold water.
Whisk peanut butter, soy sauce, vinegar, honey, ginger and warm water until smooth.
Toss the noodles with the sauce.
Serve topped with cucumber, carrots, green onions and peanuts.

recipes.title: Shrimp and cilantro-lime rice bowls
recipes.blurb: Garlicky shrimp over zesty rice with corn and avocado

steps.text: Cook the rice according to the package directions.
Stir the cilantro, lime juice and a pinch of salt into the hot rice.
Toss the shrimp with garlic, chili powder and salt.
Cook in the oil over medium-high heat 2 to 3 minutes per side until pink and opaque.
Divide the rice among 4 bowls and top with the shrimp, corn and avocado.

recipes.title: Pizza pinwheels
recipes.blurb: Crescent dough rolled with pizza sauce, cheese and pepperoni

steps.text: Heat the oven to 375 F and line a baking sheet with parchment.
Unroll the dough into one sheet and press the seams together.
Spread with sauce, then sprinkle with mozzarella, pepperoni and Italian seasoning.
Roll up tightly from the long side and slice into 12 rounds.
Bake until golden, 12 to 15 minutes. Cool, then pack with extra sauce for dipping.

recipes.title: Mini pita pizzas
recipes.blurb: Kids can build their own on small pitas

steps.text: Heat the oven to 425 F.
Place the pitas on a baking sheet and spread each with sauce.
Top with cheese, pepper, pepperoni and oregano.
Bake until the cheese bubbles and the edges crisp, 8 minutes.
Let cool a minute before cutting.

recipes.title: Peanut butter banana roll-ups
recipes.blurb: Soft tortilla, peanut butter and banana, sliced into rounds

steps.text: Spread peanut butter evenly over each tortilla.
Drizzle with a little honey.
Place a banana at the edge and roll up tightly.
Slice into 1-inch rounds and pack in a lunchbox.

recipes.title: Turkey and cheese roll-ups
recipes.blurb: Cream cheese, turkey and cheddar for no-bread lunchboxes

steps.text: Lay out the turkey slices and spread each with a thin layer of cream cheese.
Cut the cheddar slices in half and place a half on each turkey slice.
Roll up and secure each with a toothpick if needed.
Pack with cucumber sticks and tomatoes.

recipes.title: Corn dog muffins
recipes.blurb: Cornbread muffins baked around bite-size hot dogs

steps.text: Heat the oven to 400 F and grease a 12-cup mini or regular muffin pan.
Whisk the muffin mix, egg, milk and honey until just combined.
Fill each cup about two-thirds full.
Push 2 hot dog pieces into each cup of batter.
Bake until golden and a toothpick comes out clean, 12 to 15 minutes.
Serve with mustard and ketchup.

recipes.title: Cheesy broccoli bites
recipes.blurb: Soft baked bites that freeze well for lunchboxes

steps.text: Heat the oven to 400 F and line a baking sheet with parchment.
Steam or microwave the broccoli until just tender, 3 minutes, then cool.
Mix the broccoli with cheddar, eggs, panko, Parmesan, salt and pepper.
Scoop 2-tablespoon mounds onto the sheet and flatten slightly.
Bake until golden, 18 to 20 minutes, flipping once.

recipes.title: Apple and sunflower butter sandwiches
recipes.blurb: Nut-free sandwiches with crisp apple slices

steps.text: Spread sunflower butter on all 8 slices of bread.
Drizzle half of them with honey.
Layer apple slices on the honey slices and dust with cinnamon.
Top with the remaining slices and cut into triangles or fun shapes.

recipes.title: Bento-style snack box
recipes.blurb: A build-your-own box of crackers, cheese, fruit and veggies

steps.text: Wash and dry the grapes and vegetables.
Roll the turkey slices and cut each in half.
Fill the compartments of 4 lunch boxes with cheese, turkey and crackers.
Add the fruit and vegetables, then a spoonful of hummus in a small cup.
Close and chill until lunchtime.

recipes.title: Cucumber cream cheese tea sandwiches
recipes.blurb: Cool, crisp little sandwiches with dill

steps.text: Mix the cream cheese with the dill, lemon juice and a pinch of salt.
Spread on all 8 slices of bread.
Cover 4 slices with cucumber and top with the rest.
Trim the crusts if you like and cut into small rectangles or triangles.

recipes.title: Lemony tuna and cannellini salad
recipes.blurb: Protein-packed pantry salad with lemon and parsley

steps.text: Toss the beans with the onion, parsley, lemon juice and olive oil.
Flake in the tuna gently.
Season with salt and pepper.
Serve on its own, over greens or with crusty bread.

recipes.title: Caprese toast
recipes.blurb: Garlic-rubbed toast with tomato, mozzarella and basil

steps.text: Toast the bread until golden.
Rub each hot slice with the cut side of the garlic.
Top with mozzarella, tomato and basil.
Drizzle with olive oil and balsamic glaze and sprinkle with salt.

recipes.title: Egg ramen with greens
recipes.blurb: Instant ramen made into a real lunch

steps.text: Bring the water to a boil and add the noodles.
Cook for 2 minutes, then add the eggs, cracking them in gently, and the seasoning packets.
Add the spinach and simmer until the eggs are set, 2 to 3 minutes.
Stir in the sesame oil and soy sauce.
Top with green onions and serve right away.

recipes.title: Pesto tortellini with tomatoes
recipes.blurb: Fresh cheese tortellini tossed with pesto, ready in 10 minutes

steps.text: Boil the tortellini in salted water as the package directs, usually 3 to 5 minutes.
Scoop out half a cup of cooking water, then drain.
Toss the tortellini with the pesto, olive oil and a splash of cooking water.
Fold in the tomatoes and Parmesan.
Season with pepper and serve warm or cold.

recipes.title: Bean and cheese tostadas
recipes.blurb: Crisp tortillas with refried beans, cheese and fresh toppings

steps.text: Heat the oven to 400 F.
Warm the refried beans in a small pot or the microwave.
Spread beans on the tostadas, sprinkle with cheese and set on a baking sheet.
Bake until the cheese melts, 4 to 5 minutes.
Top with lettuce, tomato, avocado and salsa.

recipes.title: Chickpea feta salad
recipes.blurb: Crunchy cucumber, tomato and feta with lemon-oregano dressing

steps.text: Whisk the olive oil, lemon juice, oregano and salt.
Combine the chickpeas, cucumber, tomatoes and onion.
Add the dressing and toss.
Fold in the feta. It keeps 3 days in the fridge.

recipes.title: Cottage cheese and tomato bowls
recipes.blurb: Cool, creamy, high-protein lunch with everything bagel flavor

steps.text: Divide the cottage cheese between 2 bowls.
Top with tomatoes and cucumber.
Drizzle with the olive oil.
Sprinkle with everything bagel seasoning and pepper.

recipes.title: Hummus pita plate
recipes.blurb: A no-cook plate of hummus, warm pita and crunchy veggies

steps.text: Warm the pitas in a dry skillet or toaster, then cut into wedges.
Spread the hummus on 2 plates and make a well in the center.
Drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle with paprika.
Arrange the pita, vegetables and olives around the hummus.

recipes.title: Ricotta and berry toast
recipes.blurb: Creamy ricotta, fresh berries and a drizzle of honey

steps.text: Toast the bread until crisp.
Spread each slice generously with ricotta.
Top with berries and almonds.
Drizzle with honey and eat right away.
